assessment_run_status_timestamps.name: assessment_run_status_timestamps
assessment_run_status_timestamps.value: ("conversation_safety_assessment_run"."status" = 'pending' and "conversation_safety_assessment_run"."received_at" is null and "conversation_safety_assessment_run"."superseded_at" is null) or ("conversation_safety_assessment_run"."status" = 'received' and "conversation_safety_assessment_run"."received_at" is not null and "conversation_safety_assessment_run"."superseded_at" is null) or ("conversation_safety_assessment_run"."status" = 'superseded' and "conversation_safety_assessment_run"."superseded_at" is not null)

provider_assessment_review_linking.name: provider_assessment_review_linking
provider_assessment_review_linking.value: ("provider_assessment_review"."status" = 'confirmed' and "provider_assessment_review"."canonical_observation_id" is not null and "provider_assessment_review"."classification_source" = 'human_selected') or ("provider_assessment_review"."status" in ('dismissed', 'insufficient_information_acknowledged') and "provider_assessment_review"."canonical_observation_id" is null and "provider_assessment_review"."classification_source" is null)

safety_specification_approval_fields.name: safety_specification_approval_fields
safety_specification_approval_fields.value: ("safety_specification_version"."approval_status" = 'draft_derived' and "safety_specification_version"."approved_for_pilot_by" is null and "safety_specification_version"."approved_for_pilot_at" is null) or ("safety_specification_version"."approval_status" = 'approved_for_pilot' and "safety_specification_version"."approved_for_pilot_by" is not null and "safety_specification_version"."approved_for_pilot_at" is not null)

workflow_conversation_connection_require.name: workflow_conversation_connection_requires_authorization
workflow_conversation_connection_require.value: "workflow_conversation"."connected_at" is null or "workflow_conversation"."authorized_at" is not null

workflow_conversation_lifecycle_consiste.name: workflow_conversation_lifecycle_consistency
workflow_conversation_lifecycle_consiste.value:
("workflow_conversation"."status" = 'preparing'
        and "workflow_conversation"."provider_conversation_id" is null
        and "workflow_conversation"."authorized_at" is null
        and "workflow_conversation"."connected_at" is null
        and "workflow_conversation"."ended_at" is null
        and "workflow_conversation"."termination_reason" is null)
      or ("workflow_conversation"."status" = 'authorized'
        and "workflow_conversation"."provider_conversation_id" is not null
        and "workflow_conversation"."authorized_at" is not null
        and "workflow_conversation"."connected_at" is null
        and "workflow_conversation"."ended_at" is null
        and "workflow_conversation"."termination_reason" is null)
      or ("workflow_conversation"."status" = 'active'
        and "workflow_conversation"."provider_conversation_id" is not null
        and "workflow_conversation"."authorized_at" is not null
        and "workflow_conversation"."connected_at" is not null
        and "workflow_conversation"."ended_at" is null
        and "workflow_conversation"."termination_reason" is null)
      or ("workflow_conversation"."status" = 'ended'
        and "workflow_conversation"."provider_conversation_id" is not null
        and "workflow_conversation"."authorized_at" is not null
        and "workflow_conversation"."ended_at" is not null
        and "workflow_conversation"."termination_reason" is not null)
      or ("workflow_conversation"."status" = 'failed'
        and "workflow_conversation"."ended_at" is not null
        and "workflow_conversation"."termination_reason" is not null
        and (
          ("workflow_conversation"."provider_conversation_id" is null and "workflow_conversation"."authorized_at" is null and "workflow_conversation"."connected_at" is null)
          or ("workflow_conversation"."provider_conversation_id" is not null and "workflow_conversation"."authorized_at" is not null)
        ))

workflow_safety_consequence_state_fields.name: workflow_safety_consequence_state_fields
workflow_safety_consequence_state_fields.value: ("workflow_safety_consequence"."state" = 'required' and "workflow_safety_consequence"."ceased_by_evaluation_id" is null and "workflow_safety_consequence"."cessation_reason" is null and "workflow_safety_consequence"."ceased_at" is null) or ("workflow_safety_consequence"."state" = 'ceased' and "workflow_safety_consequence"."ceased_by_evaluation_id" is not null and "workflow_safety_consequence"."cessation_reason" is not null and "workflow_safety_consequence"."ceased_at" is not null)

workflow_safety_observation_revision_con.name: workflow_safety_observation_revision_context_pou
workflow_safety_observation_revision_con.value: ("workflow_safety_observation_revision"."assessment_context" = 'setup' and "workflow_safety_observation_revision"."pou_id" is null) or ("workflow_safety_observation_revision"."assessment_context" = 'pou' and "workflow_safety_observation_revision"."pou_id" is not null)

workflow_safety_observation_revision_rea.name: workflow_safety_observation_revision_reason
workflow_safety_observation_revision_rea.value: ("workflow_safety_observation_revision"."operation" = 'confirmed' and "workflow_safety_observation_revision"."change_reason" is null) or ("workflow_safety_observation_revision"."operation" in ('corrected', 'retracted') and length("workflow_safety_observation_revision"."change_reason") between 1 and 4000)

workflow_safety_observation_context_pou.name: workflow_safety_observation_context_pou
workflow_safety_observation_context_pou.value: ("workflow_safety_observation"."assessment_context" = 'setup' and "workflow_safety_observation"."pou_id" is null) or ("workflow_safety_observation"."assessment_context" = 'pou' and "workflow_safety_observation"."pou_id" is not null)
